a.text: We laugh together, we cry together.

spans.text: We laugh together, we cry together.

a.text: Up on this beautiful stage, we act out a vibrant monodrama.

spans.text: Up on this beautiful stage, we act out a vibrant monodrama.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Here, Saki. Drink.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: My throat doesn't hurt so much now...

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Good. Here. For you. Rim Billiton is all dust and sand. You need waterskins and goggles.
Sakiko takes each item as Mutsumi offers them. She clutches them tightly. The swollen waterskin looks fit to burst.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Saki. You seem bad. Are you sick?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No, it's nothing...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi, you... remember me?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You remember all the things we've been through?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Mmhm. I remember all of it.
Sakiko feels she can finally relax a little. She casts her gaze around—
The long, narrow mineshaft they have been following dives deep into the ground, all the way down to here.
It is damp and dark, with only oil lanterns and stoves to provide feeble pinpricks of light.
There is space for only one between the bed and dining table, and based on the number of cups on that table, Mutsumi is not living here alone.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi, how... how long have you been living here?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: A year. Maybe more. There's nothing complicated to think about here, and time doesn't pass that clearly.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No... You can't sense the passing of time because you're in a dream.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi, why would you dream of this...?

spans.text: Mutsumi, why would you dream of

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Dream...?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I have something very important to tell you, Mutsumi. None of this is real. We need to—
Oh hello, now—back already, Mutsumi-chan?
Someone rushes in behind them, and tackles Mutsumi straight down on the soft bed.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: M-Mum, you're all dusty, get off of me...
Oh, but we haven't seen each other in nearly a day! Just let me hug you a bit!

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: W-We have guests...

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Oh! If it isn't Saki-chan!

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: You haven't come over to ours in how long, now?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Minami-san...

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Oh, no need to be so formal, just 'Minami' will do.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Mmhm. Sometimes I call Mum that too.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi, since when did you have such a good relationship with Minami-san...?

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: We've always had one! We're mother and daughter, after all~

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Mutsumi-chan, how were today's earnings?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: (Sifts through pockets) It was hot today, so more people wanted cucumber juice.
Mutsumi carefully opens the pouch in her hand. Within are a scant few coins.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Hooh—attagirl, Mutsumi-chan!

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: (Sifts through pockets) Here, here's what I got.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Wow... You're amazing, Mum.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Aren't I? I don't know why, but today I had a lot more people wanting their clothes mended!

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Your dad's been working hard too, putting in a full day's work at the construction site. When I went to drop off his lunch and saw his dust-covered face and exhausted look, I gave him special permission to go for a pint after work.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: I'm sure by now, he's downed a whole tanker!

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: And to top it all off, now Saki-chan's here! You know what time I think it is? Time to get everyone together for dinner!

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: I'm glad. Eating with everyone is really nice.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Isn't it just! And today was such a good day for us, we can't go being stingy now!

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Saki-chan, don't be shy! You're invited too!

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Saki. What's wrong?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: No... Nothing...
They're clearly not a prosperous family. The bare mud walls, the dim lantern light...
Why would Mutsumi's dream be like this?

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Hello, Mutsumi, Minami... Oh, who's this?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: She's a friend from childhood. Saki.

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Hello!

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: I came over to ask if you all wanted dinner?

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: I made a lot tonight, and if you'd like, we can eat together.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: ...Now can we really accept?

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Your neighbors say there hasn't been smoke from your chimney for a few days now...

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: (Rubs stomach) Mmnh...

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Besides, it's been almost a month since the last party, right?

steps.name: Warmy
steps.text: Everyone really wants to see Mutsumi perform again.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Well, if that's the case... What do you think, Mutsumi-chan?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: M-M... Me?

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: I'm sure you want to see too, right, Saki? I could listen to it a hundred more times and still not get tired!

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: If you don't mind, we can hold the party at ours! What a coincidence, we were just talking about inviting everyone over for dinner!

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Saki, what do you think?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I think... you should make the decision, Mutsumi.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: ...Mm. I'm okay with it.
Rowdy chatter, hearty laughs, clanking cups.
The cramped house is stuffed full with people, but nobody seems to mind the lack of space.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Alright, alright, time for another round!

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: Now, a warm welcome to Mutsumi-chan's pal—Sakiko!

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Eyyy! Hello, Sakiko!
Everyone turns to look at her, sitting in the corner.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: (Lifting her pint glass) Sakiko...?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Ch—Cheers.

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Cheers—!
With her welcomed, everyone's attention returns to the party. Sakiko leans against the wall alone, her eyes a mix of emotions as she watches it all unfold.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Saki.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi...?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Actually... I know about it all.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: This is all fake. Minami being so nice to me. It's all fake.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Th-This—

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: So when I saw you, I knew, it was time to go back.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: But... give me a chance.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: A chance to say goodbye. Then we can end it.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Here, I can sing freely, just like everyone else.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Mutsumi...
Before Sakiko can even respond, Mutsumi picks up her guitar, and slowly walks up to the crowd.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: You all ready, Mutsumi-chan?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: ...Hi, everyone.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: What is it, Mutsumi-chan? Something wrong?

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: ...Chair. My chair.

steps.name: Mutsumi's Mother
steps.text: All ready for you. This one, yeah? The one you normally use?
Mutsumi stares intently at the stool, its seat covered in deep cracks.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Mm. That's it.
She slowly sits down. Everyone quiets their breathing.

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Here goes. Please enjoy...

steps.name: Mutsumi Wakaba
steps.text: Haruhikage.
A melody Sakiko could never forget comes to life once more in Mutsumi's dream.
The same warm tone she remembered subtly soothes the hearts of all present.
The Mutsumi Wakaba before her is almost a stranger to Sakiko.
She is no longer the Mutsumi who struggles to express herself.
While her emotional expressions are still not very rich, here and now, she seems... so happy.

a.text: 'A heart grown numb with cold, a trembling gaze'
'In all the world, I was alone'
'All I knew of spring was falling petals'
'And every year, my feelings are brushed off with indifference'

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: So this is what you wished for, Mutsumi...
Sakiko has had countless opportunities to pull Mutsumi away from here, and she is certain Mutsumi would follow if she did.
But ultimately, she cannot bring herself to do it.
Not when this Mutsumi is so very happy.
The crowd lightly sways to the music. The feeble candlelight casts their shadows against the wall, like warm spring sunlight casting lilting shadows of trees.
Mutsumi sits on her stool, surrounded by all. Her eyes are closed, and as she strums, she gently sings.
What is on her mind in this moment?

a.text: 'Now that I'm here, now that I feel'
'That me who couldn't cry that day'
'The light gently guides that me along with it—'

steps.text: Some indescribable emotion clouds Sakiko's mind.
Is it gratification... or a refusal to accept things? Perhaps, a mix of the two.
Mutsumi Wakaba, as she is now, is much happier than when she was with Sakiko.
She sits there, alone on her stool, earnestly singing this familiar song.

a.text: 'Shimmering and sparkling, sail through the clouds'
'Shimmering and sparkling, down my cheeks, unnoticed'
'Why is your hand so very warm?'
'Please, just stay like this and don't let go of my hands—'

steps.text: If she does not let go—
Then the happiness Mutsumi has found here—
Sakiko turns, and runs away in a panic.
And like that, she disappears into the night.
